Prioritise and Fix in Flow Results appear directly in your IDE with: * A Hackability Score (0-100) * Architecture-aware threat explanations * Exploitability-based prioritisation * Plain-language remediation guidance * “Fix” click for fixing without leaving your editor 4. Enterprise Dashboard & Policy Alignment Findings, controls, and threat models are synchronised to the Arko enterprise dashboard. Build fast. Ship secure. Control the machines. www.devsecai.io
